# Thirza Abernethy & Tranter

- [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) — Friend of — [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) — acquaintances visiting and consulting on orphan placement · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) are shocked that an orphan girl named [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) was sent instead of a boy. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) breaks down in tears upon realizing she is unwanted, but she settles in for tea and is put to bed in the east gable room. Afterward, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) discuss what to do, with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) insisting that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) must be sent back to the asylum while [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) feels reluctant to do so.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P52](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0052)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) wakes up at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and marvels at the bright June morning outside her window, though she laments that her stay will likely be brief. During breakfast and while helping with household chores, she talks incessantly to a sharp yet increasingly fascinated [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), even bestowing names like [Frost Maiden](../codex/places.md#frost-maiden) on the cherry tree and Bonny on the geranium. Afterwards, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) takes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in the buggy to [Pale Sands](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel) to meet Mrs. [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) and settle Nell's return to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), despite Obed's quiet desire to keep the girl.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P0](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P14](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P35](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P40](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0040)_

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visit Mrs. [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) to resolve the mix-up regarding the adopted child, encountering Mrs. [Scobie](../character/scobie.md) who offers to take [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Unwilling to leave the girl with Mrs. [Scobie](../character/scobie.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) delays the decision and takes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), where she and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) ultimately agree to keep her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P18](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER VI. > [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) learns that she has won the [Avery](../codex/places.md#avery) scholarship while [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) wins the Medal. After graduation, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and reunites with Isolde, before learning from [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) about Obed's failing health and concerns regarding their savings bank.
>
